title: Low-Order Inclusion Probabilities Do Not Determine Asymptotic Normality
summary: Central limit theorems in survey sampling are typically established under specific sampling designs rather than from generic characteristics of a design. Motivated by the search for more general conditions, we investigate whether low-order inclusion probabilities can provide such a basis.
